'''Pulassas Minor''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Pulassas Minor system/Legends|Pulassas Minor system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was ordered to bombard civilian targets on Pulassas Minor. Horrified by the order, the squadron's [[TIE pilot|pilot]] [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserted]] from the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], going on to join the Empire's enemy in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pulassas Minor was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pulassas Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square J-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
